title: Observational Causality
description: Evaluate observational causal claims: require an explicit causal identification strategy, test alternative mechanisms, verify source independence and search for contradictory evidence. Observational design caps the ceiling at TENTATIVE.

common_failure_modes.note: Association asserted as causation without an identification strategy.
Single mechanism assumed; alternatives not tested.
Observational datasets share a common primary chain.
Tentative evidence phrased as a strong causal claim.

escalation_conditions.when: candidate claim ceiling would exceed TENTATIVE

stop_criteria.condition: identification strategy specified, alternatives tested, contradictory evidence searched, obligations satisfied
no primary source or identification infeasible after search
